images.caption: Figure 2:(a) Existingholistic modelingregenerates the complete asset even for local modification, requiring per-task models and paired editing/completion data, while regions that should remain unchanged are often altered (black boxes). (b) Ourselective modelingsynthesizes only the designated region, unifying the three tasks, preserving the rest by construction, and needing no task-specific paired data.

Figure 3:Overview of SeMo3D. (a) Region-selective denoising. Training applies noise and loss only to a randomly selected set𝒮\mathcal{S}while keeping the context set𝒞\mathcal{C}clean; as𝒮\mathcal{S}ranges from a local box to the full region, one procedure covers editing, completion, and generation. Inference denoises𝒮\mathcal{S}from pure noise with a task-defined partition while reusing clean𝒞\mathcal{C}at every step. (b) Omni3DiT jointly processes clean context and noisy selected tokens, fusing image guidance with optional text and point conditions for fine-grained controllable synthesis.

Figure 4:Agentic 3D modeling with SeMo3D. Agent prepares input images, determines edit regions, and invokes the appropriate SeMo3D mode in response to requests. Left: generation then editing. Right: completion then editing.Refer to Supp. Mat. for video results.

Figure 5:Qualitative comparison of 3D generation on Toys4K[63]. Only top-performing baselines are shown for brevity. HY3D-Omni[29]textures are from HY3D-2.1[28]. With three complementary modalities, SeMo3D achieves more controllable and faithful generation.

Figure 6:Qualitative comparison of 3D editing on Edit3D-Bench[34]. Translucent volumes mark edit regions; points are omitted as Edit3D-Bench lacks them. Without paired editing data, SeMo3D precisely modifies the target region while preserving the rest.

Figure 7:Qualitative comparison of 3D completion on Omni-Comp[82]. Without any paired completion data, SeMo3D completes missing regions with coherent geometry that blends seamlessly with the preserved structure.†With additional sparse point guidance.
Figure 8:(a) Qualitative ablation. (b) Multimodal control: with a fixed image, varying text and points yields diverse yet faithful results.
Figure 9:Agentic 3D modeling with GPT-6 Astra[48]and Codex: (a) direct Blender coding[17]; (b) SeMo3D integration, yielding higher modeling fidelity, faster execution, and lower agent cost.
Figure 10:Failure cases: coarse fronds and missing fruits.
Figure 11:ULIP and Uni3D scores disagree with visual quality: Trellis2 is closer to the ground truth than Trellis-I but scores lower.
Figure 12:Robustness to mask size. SeMo3D yields consistent edits as the edit region (translucent) grows by up to 40%.
Figure 13:Robustness to the number of condition points. With the image and text fixed, SeMo3D preserves the overall geometry across 16, 32, and 48 points, despite being trained with at most 32.

Figure 14:Robustness to the spatial distribution of condition points. With the image and text fixed, SeMo3D produces consistent overall structure across three point distributions, with variations in local details.
